name: bloggy-webapp
description: This is a blog app created using the Flask web framework in Python for the backend and HTML/CSS & JavaScript for frontend. With this app, you can make blog posts. You will have a title and a description. The title is the subject and the description being the actual blog. You have the ability to update and delete blog posts. You can also create your bio to let others know more about you as well as a profile picture. You can click on other users' name and view their profile. The profile will include their bio and the posts that were made by that specific user. Other features include deleting your account, changing passwords, resetting passwords via email, seeing how many posts you have made, changing your email or username, and more.

paragraphs: Bloggy is a blog posting platform creating with Python & Flask. Users can register/login, post, comment, follow other users, like posts, and message others.
